annual.note: FY2025 = year ended 2025-10-31 (first ~3.5 months of Ansys, acquired 2025-07-17). Debt carrying value $13,484.515M incl. $110.585M deferred treasury-lock settlement and $13.086M other borrowings; principal outstanding Senior Notes $10.0B + Term Loans $3.45B. Noncontrolling interest is negative (-$0.587M) so recorded as 0; redeemable NCI was nil at Oct 31 2025. No convertibles, warrants or earn-outs found. Ansys assumed equity awards (1.116M RSUs, ~5K options at closing) are inside the 4.318M RSU / 1.154M option totals. Balance sheet predates the Dec 2025 $2.0B NVIDIA private placement (4.8M sh at $414.79) and FY2026 term-loan payoff.

ttm.note: Latest 10-Q filed on or before 2026-10-21 is Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-07-31, filed 2026-08-26); FY2026 10-K not yet filed. TTM = FY2025 + 9M FY26 - 9M FY25; includes ~9 months of Ansys in YTD FY26 versus 2 weeks in prior YTD, so TTM revenue is not a pro forma full-Ansys year (pro forma FY2025 revenue was $8.92B per 10-K). Op income reflects $236.3M restructuring and ~$1.2B 9M amortization of acquired intangibles. Debt carrying 10,037.360 (principal Senior Notes $10.0B + $99.526M treasury-lock deferred payment + $10.923M other = $10,110.449M). Shares 191.605M at Jul 31 includes the ~4.8M NVIDIA private-placement shares; $2.0B proceeds are in cash; $300M of buybacks in FY26 (ASR final settled 2026-06-01). NCI negative (-$1.160M) recorded as 0. No convertibles/warrants/earn-outs. A contingent consideration receivable ($22.2M, asset from the Software Integrity divestiture) and $440M divestiture proceeds are not netted.

notes: Fiscal year ends Oct 31 (fiscal 2025 = Nov 1 2024 - Oct 31 2025). Ansys acquisition closed 2025-07-17 ($~16.7B cash + stock); funded with $10.0B Senior Notes (Mar 2025) and $4.3B term loan, term loan fully repaid by Q1 FY2026.

RSU/option counts in TTM base are carried from the FY2025 10-K (10-Q silent). A search of the repo's reviewed package noted a 0.153765M proxy-vs-annual-table difference in award counts; not reconciled here.
